about_the_game:
Work together with up to 5 other friends to escape a slowly flooding facility by pressing buttons, flipping switches, toggling generators, turning valves and fixing powerboxes.

Flood Descendance is a unique spin on the delverlike genre, where instead of monsters, there's floods. Work together with up to 5 other players into a slowly flooding facility.

Your goal is to work together to trigger buttons, fix powerboxes and solve puzzles to open doors and get to the exit elevator, before the flood drowns you.

Swim your way through submerged parts of the map, but be quick! Your oxygen won't last forever.

(Quickly) parkour your way through tower sections! Don't look back; and keep moving! The flood won't wait for you.

Survived this round? Head down to the shop and purchase team-wide upgrades! You'll need it, as the facility gets harder to escape from here.

Descend down deeper into the facility. Floors get progressively harder the deeper you are.

How far will you descend?
